summary_markdown: The conversation focused on debugging and fixing data display issues within the analytics platform. Initially, a bug was identified where 'Viewable' metrics were incorrectly dropping time segments (e.g., 11 AM) from graphs even though the underlying database contained the data. Separately, [p1] found an issue with the real-time rich chart for certain facilities at the mall airport. The graph would sometimes show zero values when other data was present. This was traced to a faulty API request (`/api/dashboard/realtime/reach`) returning `f=0` for some facilities due to incorrect type handling in the calculation function. [p1] resolved this by changing the factor from `avgWeighted(f, n)` to `avgWeighted(toFloat64(f), toFloat64(n))`, which corrected the data display.
decisions: The bug causing missing 'Viewable' metrics time segments was fixed and pushed.
action_items: [p1] requested [me] review their current tasks/bugs for potential items that could be passed along, provided they are not fundamental issues.
